name: mini-ecommerce-platform
description: A mini e-commerce platform built with React, Express, and PostgreSQL.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
